bugLogs.title: Icon button missing accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the button with class 'eye' using Tab
Activate a screen reader (e.g., NVDA, VoiceOver)
Listen for the button's spoken name
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The button should have a programmatically determinable name (e.g., via visible text, aria-label, or aria-labelledby) so screen readers announce its purpose.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The button contains only an SVG icon and has no inner text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or associated label, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add an accessible name, e.g., <button type="button" class="eye" aria-label="Show password"><svg ...></svg></button>

bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for error message text
steps_to_reproduce: Enter an invalid email or password and submit the form
Observe the error message "Incorrect email or password" displayed
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Error message text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the background.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The error message uses color #e8a0a0 on a white background (#ffffff), resulting in a contrast ratio of 2.1:1, which fails the minimum requirement.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for p, change color from #e8a0a0 to #996a6a (4.54:1 on #ffffff; measured 2.1:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Login form inputs lack persistent visible labels
steps_to_reproduce: Focus on the email input field
Observe that the placeholder text disappears and no label is announced
Repeat for the password input field
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each form input must have a persistent visible label (or an accessible name via aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title) that remains visible when the field receives focus, allowing screen readers and all users to identify the purpose of the field.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Both the email and password inputs rely solely on placeholder text for identification; they have no associated <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attributes.
bugLogs.suggested_fix:
Add explicit <label> elements linked to each input and optionally keep the placeholder for visual hint. Example:

<label for="login-email" class="sr-only">Email</label>
<input type="email" id="login-email" placeholder="Email" aria-required="true">

<label for="login-password" class="sr-only">Password</label>
<input type="password" id="login-password" placeholder="Password" aria-required="true">
